brief: Rewrite PRODUCT.md under D-091 and say what the focus changes in the order.
tradeoff: Given up: PRODUCT.md's code-simplicity line (now AGENTS.md's alone), its file-name pointers, and 3 places of order for the tasks at 52 to 72.
entry: PRODUCT.md is rewritten under D-091 to hold only the product and its direction. jellyscale is the back end and Octave the front end it ships. Goal 3 adds "Octave's features have the server they need". "No jellyscale work goes in for Octave" is withdrawn, completing D-089's lift of D-027: the server side of Octave's features is jellyscale's work, while Octave itself stays its own project's and needs nothing only jellyscale has. No viewer or operator guarantee is removed. JS-053, JS-052 and JS-046 take priorities 52 to 54. JS-032 and JS-049 wait for Octave's statement or dogfood counts.
serves: Owner, 2026-11-26 (D-091): "focus on the back end work and also supporting Octave features"; PRODUCT.md: "Their library feels alive".
